messages:
anya: FYI i'm creating a single "troubleshooting/error-reference" PR that bundles 429, timeout, and context-limit guidance + tiny SDK cookbooks. aim: compact runbook, runnable examples, and a deterministic sim harness. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/4927 :books:

trent: sgtm. for the harness can we run a small Flask app that exposes `/simulate` with params `?status=429&delay=200`? we need to assert `Retry-After` behavior and simulated burst windows.

kai: yes, and add a mode that streams partial tokens then cuts the stream (to test resume/interrupt). keep examples in both node/python. i can do the streaming snippet.

roxanne: for the docs text, keep the fallback options explicit: 1) backoff+retry (with jitter), 2) shorten prompt (with example algorithm), 3) route to cheaper-compatible model. one sentence about tradeoffs for each. keep language prescriptive.

anya: here's a quick node example i'll put in the PR comments:
```
// pseudo-node
const res = await redwood.generate({ model: 'rwd-small', prompt });
if (res.status === 429) {
  const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0', 10);
  await sleep((ra || backoff.next()) * 1000);
  return retry();
}
```

trent: for python i'll add a snippet using the SDK client that inspects `response.headers.get('retry-after')` and falls back to `trim_context()` helper if retries exceed 3.

kai: streaming note (draft): when a streaming connection is interrupted, clients should attempt a short reconnect plus resume using the last known token index if the model supports it; otherwise fall back to a non-streaming request with trimmed context. i'll link streaming-resume.md.

roxanne: QA checklist proposal: run harness with burst pattern, verify `Retry-After` header format (seconds vs HTTP-date), confirm metric `client.429.handled` increments, validate SDK snippet runs in CI smoke job. also add a flakiness note (time-based tests are brittle).

docs-bot: lint: error-ref/429-and-timeouts.md line 28: use present-tense imperative. line 99: missing language spec on code block.

anya: will fix bot comments and add explicit fenced block languages.

trent: telemetry suggestion: emit `client_429_handled` with schema: `model`, `strategy` (values: retry_trim_model), `retry_attempts`, `elapsed_ms`. keep schema tiny and stable for dashboards.

kai: i'll add the streaming partial-retry integration test to the harness so QA can hit both interrupt+resume and full disconnect. simple curl commands suffice.

roxanne: ownership: anya (lead doc prose + PR), trent (harness + python snippets), kai (streaming examples + test integration), i'll do review pass on tradeoffs section and UX bullets.

anya: landing plan: open PR now, wait for snippets + tests, tag `@eng-qa` and `@devex` for a smoke run. target merge by EOD Friday.

trent: i'll push the flask harness and a `scripts/simulate-429.sh` wrapper in next 40m.

kai: pushed preliminary streaming snippet to PR comment. also added a curl resume example.

roxanne: thanks all. small ask: add a one-line note about how fallback impacts cost telemetry (cheaper model means different token accounting). otherwise lgtm.

anya: noted and added that line. merging when CI + QA sign off.
